skin_exposure: bold — more bare shoulder and collarbone inside the crop; the crop stays exactly where CROP sets it and never moves down to show more; cover the chest

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, armor, regalia, ornaments, mecha plates or background.
